articles.title: Blue Cloud Softech partners with Mahesh Babu Foundation for GMB Life app launch
articles.description: Blue Cloud Softech partners with Mahesh Babu Foundation to deploy AI-based BluHealth platform. GMB Life wellness app launched on August 31, 2026, offering contactless screening via smartphone. Future phase includes healthcare kiosks with local doctor consultations at selected locations. Company reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,002 crore, up 26% year-on-year. Association is not expected to have a material financial impact in the current fiscal year.

articles.title: OpenAI Ends Cursor Partnership Over SpaceX Buyout; Elon Musk Says 'I Couldn't Care Less'
articles.description: OpenAI has told Cursor it will wind down direct access to its AI models, with November 12 proposed as the cut-off date. The decision follows SpaceX’s acquisition of Cursor parent Anysphere and reflects OpenAI’s concerns over contract compliance. Musk hit back on X, calling Sam Altman and Greg Brockman untrustworthy.

articles.title: MBA vs engineers: The 52% pay gap that could change your career choice
articles.description: The future of work is moving beyond the old engineering-versus-MBA divide. As AI takes over more technical tasks, the premium is shifting towards people who can connect technology with business, make sound decisions and lead through change. The real advantage may belong to those who can bridge both worlds.
